title: spawn_sse retries forever on 401 or 403 auth errors
description: client.rs spawn_sse applies exponential backoff on any Err from run_sse including HTTP 401/403. Auth errors mean the server is reachable but identity is wrong; retrying accomplishes nothing. UI shows Reconnecting forever. watch.rs exits cleanly on 401/403. Fix: detect 4xx from ClientError::Http and exit the SSE task instead of retrying.
